bio: I am a software engineer with a Mechanical Engineering background from Institut Teknologi Bandung, focused on full-stack products, AI-enabled systems, and software that interfaces with physical systems.

I have built and led production-oriented platforms for education, student organizations, personal productivity, industrial interfaces, and robotics, working across product design, frontend, backend, data, cloud infrastructure, and embedded integration.
My engineering background gives me a systems perspective: I am comfortable moving from product requirements and data models to APIs, interfaces, deployment, telemetry, and hardware constraints.

education.description: 2022-2026. GPA: 3.9/4.00. Coursework and projects span mechanical systems, control, computation, robotics, and applied software engineering.
